query: Which de-identification methods and membership-inference evaluations best protect humanities-rich artifacts (poems, diaries, drawings) from memorization or provenance leakage?

response.query: Which de-identification methods and membership-inference evaluations best protect humanities-rich artifacts (poems, diaries, drawings) from memorization or provenance leakage?
response.answer: For humanities-rich artifacts, differential privacy and data anonymization best protect against memorization or provenance leakage. Tokenization and aggregation techniques also help safeguard sensitive details.
